item.title: Northwind Bank launches bill split for any card payment in its app
item.description: Northwind Bank in the United Kingdom has launched a bill split feature. Customers can split any past card payment with friends, who pay back by phone number. The feature is live for all retail customers.

item.title: Pioneer Wallet rolls out tap to pay on phones for small merchants in Spain
item.description: Pioneer Wallet has rolled out a SoftPOS feature that lets small merchants in Spain accept contactless card payments on an Android phone, with no extra hardware.
